scope: Methodology, arithmetic, complete recorded-claim membership, advisory family preservation, fail-closed source/receipt/input binding, tests and workload-guide assertions. No fresh source-semantic certification.

claim_document_binding.document_hashes_location: inputs.claim_documents in the exact-bound workload inventory

method: Read final local module, all scoped tests, guide and plan; inspect existing source/claim/receipt shapes as data.

Independently reconstruct every claim identity and family membership from all 654 documents; compare every member and family key, raw provider identities, full path/ordinal rows, query-help identities, all arithmetic and document hashes.
Verify supplied source artifact metadata against the pinned original inventory and exact 474 receipt subject/hash bindings. Reproduce final inventory object exactly with the final module.
Run all13 scoped tests and five additional independent temporary-fixture rejection cases. No full-corpus semantic reread or upstream execution.
Confirm tracked source, controls, reconciliation and recovery bytes were not changed by this work; review only new audit artifacts.

resolved_findings.problem: Initial final hash loop could miss a new claim document added while constructing the full inventory.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final sorted path membership is compared with the initial list, then all initial document and artifact/receipt bytes are rechecked.
resolved_findings.independent_verification: New document introduced during a read rejects; regression test passes.

resolved_findings.problem: Initial receipt source locator checks omitted exact content/statement/document hashes; supplied claim/document artifact metadata could be silently overridden.
resolved_findings.resolution: Exact content, statement and document receipt hashes are checked; supplied claim or inherited document artifact/content bindings must match indexed source identity. Missing legacy metadata remains derived from the pinned index and fully bound document.
resolved_findings.independent_verification: All 474 current receipt subjects validate; wrong claim artifact ID, wrong document artifact ID and wrong document content hash reject; targeted regressions pass.

resolved_findings.problem: Incomplete typed provider context could fall back to generic artifact context, including when the display credential identifier was absent.
resolved_findings.resolution: Any intersection with the six provider classification keys requires all six keys, then field/types/range validation.
resolved_findings.independent_verification: Missing definition end without display identifier rejects; full current claim-document corpus has no partial typed contexts; regression passes.

executed_validation.full_repository_suite: Not independently rerun in this bounded audit.

root_reported_validation.full_production_provenance_and_recovery: Matches prior committed accounting except generated_at

residual_limits: 61936 is the 654 claim-document lane, not the full source omission or distinct-obligation denominator. Existing B0/C0 227 propositions retain separate accounting.
Provider/query typing is existing authored metadata. This audit verifies preservation and bindings, not source values, semantic equivalence, obligation modality, omissions, or live capability.
Shared family membership, exact text and shared spans grant no exclusions, dispositions, review/reconciliation credit, adoption, rights or native enforcement credit.
Receipt records here are source-bound and counted; authority, reviewer, disposition and acceptance validation remain owned by the existing reconciliation contract.

655th future document or changed bytes require regeneration/review; observed endpoint hash and membership checks do not provide an operating-system atomic snapshot or detect an adversarial change-and-restore between reads.
No semantic workers, external cloud workers, provider/native/billing operations or control changes occurred in this audit; acceptance gates remain open.
